approved: The Imported Food Charges (Imposition-Excise) Bill 2015 was introduced as part of a legislative package to impose excise charges on imported food, with the amounts and exemptions to be set in delegated legislation rather than the bill itself.

The Imported Food Charges (Collection) Bill 2015 provides the authority to collect charges for imported food cost recovery, with regulations setting payment times, agent liability, and late fees. It includes non-payment measures such as suspending certificates and recovering debts, while allowing refunds at the Agriculture Secretary's discretion.
